Alger, 30 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 30, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Orange Cyberdefense is integrating the Mistral Large 4 model into its security offerings, with gradual deployment planned for certain corporate and public sector customers. The deal gives the company access to a cybersecurity-optimized variant.
Intégration de Mistral Large 4 et usages: Integration of Mistral Large 4 and uses in cybersecurity
Orange Cyberdefense va incorporer Mistra: Orange Cyberdefense will incorporate Mistral Large 4, also known as "Le Chonk", into its security offerings. The agreement concluded offers access to a version of Mistral Large 4 refined for advanced cybersecurity applications, specifically including intrusion testing, vulnerability assessment and red-teaming. According to the company Mistral, this access remains restricted to carefully selected partners and is governed by strict controls as well as contractual commitments.
Le système se présente comme une archite: The system is presented as an open architecture with a thousand billion parameters, designed on European territory. The publisher specifies that it reaches fifty-one percent on the Artificial Analysis Cyber ​​Index, an index evaluating the ability to identify, reproduce and correct flaws within computer code.
Enjeux de souveraineté et axes d'interve: Sovereignty issues and areas of intervention
Du côté d'Orange, l'exécution des modèle: On Orange's side, the execution of models dedicated to security operations will be carried out on a calculation infrastructure located in Europe. This provision aims to consolidate digital sovereignty while satisfying compliance requirements. For its part, Mistral relies on open weight models, allowing entities to review, modify and install these solutions on their own infrastructure. The publisher highlights the ability to process source code, security telemetry, incident logs or threat intelligence in a controlled framework, free from any recourse to an external API.
Dans un premier temps, les efforts d'Ora: Initially, Orange Cyberdefense's efforts will focus on two main directions: the detection of vulnerabilities in customer devices ahead of possible exploitation by attackers, and the acceleration of the investigation phases when a security incident occurs. Furthermore, Mistral lists several use cases for this type of model, including code review and development of patches, analysis of applications and cloud configurations, or even support for investigation by cross-checking events from various security tools.
Auteur d'un chiffre d'affaires de un vir: Author of a turnover of one point three billion euros in 2025, Orange Cyberdefense has not disclosed any details concerning the financial aspects of the agreement. This partnership extends a larger collaboration established between Orange and Mistral in 2025.
